description.ja: 『ARMORED CORE VI FIRES OF RUBICON』のアイテムが30 MINUTES MISSIONSシリーズで商品化。
description.en: "ARMORED CORE VI FIRES OF RUBICON" items are commercialized in the 30 MINUTES MISSIONS series.

description.ja: シリーズのキーコンセプト「シンプル組立」「カスタム遊び」のもと、人気のレーザーライフルを含めた武器群がオプションパーツセットで登場。
description.en: Based on the series' key concepts of "simple assembly " and " custom play," a group of weapons including the popular laser rifle are now available as optional parts sets.

description.ja: • 左右装備時に形状が変わる武装は、右再現用・左再現用のパーツがそれぞれ付属し、選択式で組み立て可能。
description.en: • Weapons that change shape when equipped on the left and right come with parts for right and left reproduction, and can be assembled selectively.

description.ja: • 「VP-67LD」にはクリア成形のエフェクトパーツが付属し、展開状態を再現可能。
description.en: • "VP-67LD" comes with clear molded effect parts, allowing you to reproduce the unfolded state.
